context: Two friends discuss a film about a chef
purpose: Teach: 岡崎/星野/ウィリアム/デイヴィッド/ゲイツ/蘭/是非とも/アタック

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨夜の映画、岡崎シェフの伝記、感動的だった。
lines.en: Last night's film really moved me — Chef Okazaki's biopic.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Gently nostalgic tone. Slight pause after the dash, as if reliving the moment. Warm exhale on 'moved'.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 共演の星野女優、目力すごいよね。
lines.en: The co-star Hoshino has such intensity in her eyes.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the voice. Quiet and observant. Leans forward slightly with the compliment. No performance — just noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 監督はイギリス人のウィリアムさん、味のある演出。
lines.en: The director — he's British, William — he brings such character to every shot.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost studying the words as she speaks them. Slight pause before 'William' to place him. Warm recognition of craft.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 撮影助手のデイヴィッドさん、海外で評価されてる。
lines.en: The camera assistant, David, he's getting real recognition overseas too.
lines.style: Brightening slightly. Genuine delight in someone else's success. Light, unforced energy. No envy — just pleasure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: プロデューサーのゲイツ氏、独立系の名門。
lines.en: The producer, Gates — he's got that independent prestige touch all over this.
lines.style: More animated now. Slight quickening of pace. Appreciative of the whole architecture. Not showing off knowledge — just seeing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 劇中、和食店に飾られた蘭、印象的だった。
lines.en: Those orchids they had displayed in the restaurant scene — they stayed with me.
lines.style: Gentle and specific. Lingers on the word 'orchids' like she's still seeing them. Quiet recognition of a small beautiful detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: I really do want to see the sequel.
lines.style: Simple, sincere. Warm, almost childlike in its honesty. No irony — genuine anticipation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 予告で、フィナーレのアタック演出、エモかったよね。
lines.en: The finale in the trailer — the way they cut it together — it was so affecting.
lines.style: Bright and animated. Enthusiasm without loudness. Quick, engaged rhythm. Light, natural smile in the voice.
